strings.index.text05: Did you know that Western astrology is still fixed to where the stars stood 2,000 years ago? Because of the tilt of the Earth's axis (precession), the calendar signs have drifted about 24 degrees from the sky itself. Vedic astrology reads the actual positions of the stars you would see through a telescope tonight, so discovering your true sign brings your unconscious mind, instincts, talents and destiny — and any sense that something never quite fit — into focus.

strings.index.text20: Your own cosmic blueprint, revealed with the highest astronomical precision
strings.index.text21: Has the sun sign of Western astrology ever explained everything about your complicated life?
strings.index.text22: If ordinary horoscopes have always left you vaguely unsatisfied, there is a clear reason: they do not reflect the real positions of the planets in tonight's sky.
strings.index.text24: combines the wisdom of the Vedas — the sacred texts of India, more than 5,000 years old — with the precise calculation logic of modern astronomy. As the name Libertas (freedom) suggests, this site exists not to bind you to fatalism, but to help you take back sovereignty over your own life and open your future with the genuine wisdom of the stars.
strings.index.text25: 1. The decisive difference from Western astrology: the sidereal method, aligned with real space
strings.index.text26: The greatest difference between Western astrology and Vedic astrology (Jyotish) lies in how the ecliptic — the path of the stars — is calculated.
strings.index.text28: Calculated from the vernal equinox of some 2,000 years ago, fixed to the cycle of the seasons.
strings.index.text30: Corrects the drift caused by the tilt of the Earth's axis (precession) down to the smallest unit, and calculates from the real positions of the planets in tonight's sky.
strings.index.text31: Because of the Earth's precession, the real sky and the calendar signs have drifted apart by about 24 degrees (this precise correction value is called the Ayanamsa).
strings.index.text32: LIBERTAS JYOTISH computes the astronomical Ayanamsa with great care. From the real signs and planetary degrees actually present in the sky above you tonight, we build your own cosmic blueprint (your horoscope, the Rashi Chakra) exactly as it is — not as comforting words.
strings.index.text33: 2. Three specialist systems of interpretation behind the precision
strings.index.text34: We present this as the most refined divination in the world because of the depth of its layered calculation and logic.
strings.index.text35: ① The 27 lunar mansions, the Nakshatras
strings.index.text36: Going beyond the twelve signs of Western astrology (a coarse division of 30 degrees each), we use the Nakshatras, which divide the Moon's path into 27 finer regions. They bring the deep psychology hidden within a single sign, the habits of your subconscious, your patterns in relationships and the true purpose of your soul into microscopic focus.
strings.index.text37: ② Vimshottari Dasha, the precise timeline of your life
strings.index.text38: Dasha is Vedic astrology's own timing system, and it identifies when the turning points of your life will arrive with remarkable precision. Starting from the Moon's Nakshatra at the moment of your birth, it calculates in layers which planet's influence you are living under, and works out the decisive moments and strategies of your life: when to push, and when to consolidate.
strings.index.text39: ③ Lagna, which defines the vessel of your soul
strings.index.text40: Using not only your date of birth but a confirmed time of birth and the precise latitude and longitude of your birthplace, we calculate exactly which point the eastern horizon was facing at the moment you were born — your Lagna (ascendant, or first house). With the Lagna as the axis, the true structure of a person, woven by the nine planets (Navagraha) and the twelve houses, can be analysed in three dimensions.
strings.index.text41: 3. Remedies and harmony: the true wisdom that sets you free
strings.index.text42: Jyotish, called the science of light in ancient India, is far more than predicting the future.
strings.index.text43: Our readings include Vedic remedies (upaya) as standard, to ease the pressure of the planets. Through mantras chosen for you (specific frequencies of sound), adjustments of colour and Ayurvedic changes to your constitution (dosha balancing), we offer concrete solutions that harmonise planetary energy and draw out your full potential.
strings.index.text44: 4. An uncompromising commitment to mathematical and astronomical accuracy
strings.index.text45: The LIBERTAS JYOTISH calculation engine is built on a world-class astronomical library (Swiss Ephemeris compliant). It corrects historical timezone changes, small differences in daylight saving time and precise coordinates in real time.
strings.index.text46: We never output abstract poetry or recycled text that would fit anyone. We extract only the mathematical and astronomical facts the universe gave you, and deliver them as the true light that illuminates your life.
strings.index.text47: Are you ready to decode your true position among the stars?
strings.index.text48: Enter your birth data and receive the genuine roadmap that LIBERTAS JYOTISH reveals for you alone.
